about: The devnet index's opinion of each issuer, in the shape of index/config/issuers.json. On devnet, list 0 is owned by the devnet issuer key devnet/keys.sh derives (label `issuer`, docs/devnet.md), which the devnet registry build names as FOUNDATION_ISSUER. It counts 1, as the foundation's list does in index/config/issuers.json; every other key counts 0.
